200.title: Poland halted asylum claims at the Belarus border and now wants Europe to follow its example
200.summary: When Poland stopped registering asylum applications from migrants entering from Belarus in March 2025, authorities presented it as a temporary emergency measure to counter what they saw as a push by Russia and its ally Belarus to destabilize the country by directing tens of thousands of migrants toward the European Union.
200.body: When Poland stopped registering asylum applications from migrants entering from Belarus in March 2025, authorities presented it as a temporary emergency measure to counter what they saw as a push by Russia and its ally Belarus to destabilize the country by directing tens of thousands of migrants toward the European Union. But the policy has remained in force for the last 18 months, and Poland is now urging the 27-nation bloc to allow temporary suspensions of asylum applications during episodes of “instrumentalized” mass migration elsewhere — a move that rights advocates warn could violate international law. Duszczyk said that the suspension of the right to asylum in Poland is fully compatible with international law and that people in the most vulnerable categories — pregnant women, children or those facing persecution in Belarus — can still apply for asylum even under the current system.

300.title: Turkish autos gain edge over Chinese rivals with Customs Union, Polish official says
300.summary: Türkiye’s automotive industry has a major competitive advantage over Chinese rivals because vehicles produced in the country can enter the European Union without the import tariffs imposed on Chinese vehicles, according to Bartosz Mielecki, managing director of the Polish Automotive Group (PGM).
300.body: Türkiye’s automotive industry has a major competitive advantage over Chinese rivals because vehicles produced in the country can enter the European Union without the import tariffs imposed on Chinese vehicles, according to Bartosz Mielecki, managing director of the Polish Automotive Group (PGM). Speaking at a mobility conference in Katowice on Thursday as part of the "Poland Business Forward" program, Mielecki pointed to Türkiye’s Customs Union with the EU as a key advantage. "Türkiye has a major competitive advantage because vehicles produced there can enter the EU without the import tariff that Chinese vehicles have to pay," Mielecki explained. He also noted that Chinese brands nearly doubled their share of the Polish automotive market, rising from 6% to about 13% in one year.

500.title: Ready to Put Your Work on 'Autopilot'? Microsoft Readies Its AI Agent for Release
500.summary: Because Autopilot runs in the cloud and plugs into Microsoft 365 apps, regional rollouts will likely follow existing Copilot deployments—see Microsoft's recent work on UAE sovereign AI agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot —with enterprise guardrails front and center when it lands.
500.body: (Credit: Microsoft) As personal AI agents pick up steam, Microsoft is getting closer to launching its own in "Autopilot," which is arriving first for business users, but will eventually launch for consumers, too. Because Autopilot runs in the cloud and plugs into Microsoft 365 apps, regional rollouts will likely follow existing Copilot deployments—see Microsoft's recent work on UAE sovereign AI agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot —with enterprise guardrails front and center when it lands. Microsoft first tipped Autopilots at its Build conference in June, describing them as "always-on agents that work autonomously, with their own identity, and act on your behalf." At the time, Scout was introduced as Microsoft's "first Autopilot agent," but the company is now dropping that name and sticking with Autopilot.
